objs.name: document
objs.description: Artifact managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, revision, invalidation, reactivation and translation.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used for a document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of a document in its status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed into a document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted, starting from release of a document.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Distribution attribute whose change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution attribute whose change affects workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document; document types can have templates and defined validity and archive periods.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating a new document or adding information to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object that can supplement a document with additional information and can be released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document dependent on a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document that must be checked when validity approaches expiry.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a document to invalidate and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for document processes and acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person acting in the system as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, applicant or initiator.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented to provide functions according to area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access or business administration permissions.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned at user group or person level for a document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing User Groups and persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: System notification informing involved users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, override, release or acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific display listing documents relevant to users according to distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and authorizations via document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current document version or relevant document information on the web or dashboard.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an Attachment with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released, automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Inform users by e-mail about statuses, workflow tasks or document-related actions.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Complete workflow task with electronic signature and document the signature for the released version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change Proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change Proposals in the Change Proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a Request For Validity Extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process the override request with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare document and its attachments out of force and archive them.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after archive period expiry.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process the reactivation request with workflow support.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version and restore document from invalidated status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons in the Distribution List for a document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Notify assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements using dashboards or reports.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Check and release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local change or extension.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: Document has a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
Additional Info can be added to each document.
Attachment is associated with a main document and released with it.
Change Proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Request For Validity Extension is linked to the document to be checked.
Request For Override is created for a selected document.
Request For Reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution List is maintained per document.
Persons can be assigned directly to the Distribution List.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution List.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Personal authorizations are assigned to users.
Group-related authorizations are assigned via User Groups.
Acknowledgements are documented for document versions.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Documents already in the system can be linked with other documents, and local documents can reference original documents.
